title: Claude using my personal account rather than my organization account
body:
I had a paid claude account to try it out. Loved it. I then had my admin buy my team an organization license and switched to it. Problem is, when i log in with Claude.code i get tacked onto my personal org rather than my organization.

Is there any way to fix this? Was looking at deleting my person account. 

Thanks in advance for any help you may offer.

Love, love, love the tool though.

R
author: rhys-041

top_comments.author: ghost
top_comments.body:
You should be able to sign in with another account by first running `$ claude /logout` and then restarting `$ claude`. Then, in your browser, select "Switch account" on the bottom of the page. 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/bdf24cca-696e-4387-9d43-6aacc4c28e38)

top_comments.author: rhys-041
top_comments.body:
Thanks. The issue is that I used the same email address for both accounts.
:( So now, whenever i try to /logout /login i am getting stuck choosing the
personal account. Do i need to have a different email address?
